answer: Jurors who vote in lockstep lose their grading pay. Seats come from a yarrow draw seeded by each close hash, so no key picks its panel, and a key's signal is its string of 0-3 scores on its last 20 seats. When two keys have judged 10 of the same answers, a mirror check compares each signal; matching on 9 of 10 marks one controller, as honest jurors match about 60%. A farm running one script always matches, so each fake forfeits the 15 POA of grading pay earned that window: 1,000 fakes x 15 POA = 15,000 POA.
